issues.explanation: The change ships no Pest/PHPUnit tests, although the project's TDD convention requires a test for every feature and both an unauthorized-call and a tamper test for each Livewire action.

The component's Entity is a public property with no #[Locked] and is authorized only in mount(), which is not re-run on Livewire update requests, so a tampered payload can rebind it to an entity the user does not belong to.
The custom current_entity middleware is not registered with Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware([...]), so the tenant resolution and 403 check silently stop applying to /livewire/update requests.

submit() is a public Livewire endpoint but never calls $this->authorize('create', Entity::class) (nor checks the authenticated user) before writing the entity and ownership, contrary to the 'authorize every action server-side' rule.

The switcher renders the layout as an anonymous component (<x-layouts::default-page>) whereas the rest of the change addresses it as the view namespace layouts::default-page; without an anonymous component namespace registration this page cannot render.
Authorization is done with a hand-written membershipFor() check instead of the EntityPolicy/gate that the conventions mandate for authorization.

Creating the entity plus owner membership is a domain write performed inline in the component instead of through an app/Actions class, which the conventions require (and which would also centralize authorization).
The resolved entity is published under four request attributes and two container instances (including Entity::class), which is speculative duplication of a single tenant context.
The 0-memberships/1-membership/many-memberships dispatch is copied from the middleware, so the onboarding/switcher rules must now be kept in sync in two places.
Slug-collision detection matches generic 'unique constraint'/'duplicate entry' text, so an unrelated unique violation (e.g. entity_memberships) would be retried five times before surfacing.
render() calls ->layout() even though #[Layout('layouts::card-page')] is already declared on the class; the same duplication exists in app/Livewire/Entity/Dashboard.php:31.
This file and both Livewire views (create-entity.blade.php, dashboard.blade.php) end without a trailing newline.
Keys create_entity, onboarding_title, onboarding_heading and create_company are added in both locales but never used; only switch_entity and the two onboarding texts are needed.

review.summary: The change implements the entity data model, policies, tenant middleware, onboarding, switcher, dashboard, routes and lang strings largely in line with the task and with a portable one-owner generated column. It ships no tests at all, and its Livewire authorization has real gaps: the dashboard entity is unlocked and only authorized in mount(), the custom tenant middleware is not persistent, and submit() never authorizes. Those points plus the duplicated dispatch/aliasing mean it needs substantial rework before merging.
